captions_note: the scattered words ARE the reel's words for the hook: fx_add.py hides the reel's captions only while the words are up (work/reel_captions.json)
in_a_reel: start the slot about 0.1 s before the first word of the hook and end it about 0.3 s after the phrase

the buyer's style wins: set the STYLE block at the top of build.py to the reel's caption style (font, weight, tracking, case, ink, accent) before the first build (effects/INDEX.md, Restyling an effect's own words)
steps: run build.py SAFE=1      # prints each word, size and place, the snapshot times and the caption window
run check.py      # frame count, work/check/sheet.jpg, phone copy
